doc: NanoChat (Karpathy, native transformers 5 class): every RMSNorm is WEIGHTLESS (x * rsqrt(mean x^2 + eps)), an extra weightless RMS norm on the embeddings before the layers, an ungated fc1/fc2 MLP with ReLU^2, final_logit_softcapping, and per-head q/k RMS norms applied AFTER the rotation (HF: 'RoPE -> Norm instead of the usual Norm -> RoPE'). The post-rotation order is FR-02: this adapter applies the norm BEFORE the rotation, the only order the spec has, so it is expected to stop at float_vs_hf. PENDING VALIDATION (written during the quiet window). Third-party adapter (lane H): data only.
